## Problem

What problem would this solve? (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you'd like to see.

## Which part of the tool

- [ ] Device discovery
- [ ] Port scanning
- [ ] Service / OS detection
- [ ] WiFi testing (must stay behind the `authorized_targets.json` scope gate)
- [ ] GUI
- [ ] Results / export
- [ ] Packaging / releases
- [ ] Docs

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you've thought of.

## Notes

ShibaCuddles is for authorized security testing and education only.
Features that would weaken the authorized-use scope gating (non-private
target confirmation, `authorized_targets.json` allowlisting) won't be
accepted.
